name: gpt2codex
description: Read a local project in ChatGPT and hand implementation work to Codex desktop.

interface.shortDescription: Read locally, then hand work to Codex desktop.
interface.longDescription: gpt2codex lets ChatGPT inspect a bound local project, prepare a focused implementation brief, and create or continue a matching task in Codex desktop. ChatGPT only reads project files; Codex performs edits and verification.
defaultPrompt: 读取我的本地项目，制定方案并交给 Codex 桌面端执行
继续把这个需求交给已绑定的 Codex 任务
